_comment: Capability catalog (TOOL-01) — versioned registry of systems the harness may reach. Read by BOTH gsd-tools.cjs (Node) and capability_schema.py (Python). Entry 'name' is a STABLE ID: Phase 67's PreToolUse hook consumes this catalog as its allowlist — never rename/remove a name without a catalog_version bump. Auth stores method + env-var NAME only, never secret values. Author entries via 'gsd-amauta capability add'; 'gsd-amauta capability audit' catches hand-edit schema drift. v1.1 (Phase 68): added the additive 'local-tool' kind for mobile/wearable build-loop registrations (xcodebuildmcp, mobile-mcp, gradlew, xcodebuild).

entries.name: amauta-daemon-http
entries.notes: Local Amauta daemon HTTP API (tasks, memory, audit). Port override: GSD_AMAUTA_PORT.

entries.name: amauta-postgres
entries.notes: Primary PG store. DSN carries credentials — responses are evidence-scrub targets (MOBL-04 foundation).

entries.name: amauta-valkey
entries.notes: Valkey/Redis — circuit breakers, semantic cache. Default redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0.

entries.name: xcodebuildmcp-server
entries.notes: iOS/watchOS build-test-simulator MCP loop; registration gated on mobile executors installed (bin/install.js); build output is an evidence-scrub target (MOBL-04); degraded per services/mobile_toolchain.py when no simulator.

entries.name: mobile-mcp-server
entries.notes: OPT-IN (--enable-mobile-mcp / GSD_MOBILE_MCP=on), pre-1.0 pinned EXACTLY 0.0.61 never a floating/unpinned tag, accessibility-tree snapshots = deterministic UAT ground truth (MOBL-05).

entries.name: gradlew-android-loop
entries.notes: Target-repo wrapper only, never a global Gradle. Allowlisted Bash commands assembleDebug / testDebugUnitTest / lint -- NO Gradle MCP (locked anti-feature); Phase 67 PreToolUse consumes this entry as the allowlist source.

entries.name: xcodebuild-ios-cli
entries.notes: Raw CLI loop already described in the executors' build-loop sections (headings vary per file); simulator destinations only (no signing).
